# Worldometers

> > Real-time global statistics and live counters tracking world population, COVID-19, CO2 emissions, demographics, and country-specific data sourced from the United Nations and international organizations.

Worldometers provides continuously updated statistical data on global metrics including population dynamics, coronavirus pandemic tracking, carbon emissions, and comprehensive country profiles. The site aggregates data from authoritative sources like the UN Department of Economic and Social Affairs Population Division and World Population Prospects: The 2024 Revision.

## Key Topics

- COVID-19 pandemic statistics
- World population demographics
- CO2 emissions and fossil fuels
- United Nations population data
- Population growth and density
- Per capita emissions
- Fertility rates
- Urbanization trends
- Country-specific statistics
- Climate and environmental data
- Historical demographic data
- Real-time global counters
- UN geoscheme classifications

## Coronavirus & Health Statistics

- [COVID - Coronavirus Statistics - Worldometer](https://www.worldometers.info/coronavirus): Real-time COVID-19 global statistics with historical data and charts

## Global Reference & Geography

- [List of Countries of the world in alphabetical order (A to Z) - Worldometer](https://www.worldometers.info/geography/alphabetical-list-of-countries): A-Z country list with population, density, and land area data
- [Continents - Worldometer](https://www.worldometers.info/geography/continents): Continent classification models: 4 to 7 continents explained

## Country Population Statistics

- [Afghanistan Population (2026) - Worldometer](https://www.worldometers.info/world-population/afghanistan-population): Afghanistan demographics: population growth, fertility, urbanization
- [Senegal Population (2026) - Worldometer](https://www.worldometers.info/world-population/senegal-population): Senegal population statistics with fertility and urbanization trends
- [Bosnia and Herzegovina Population (2026) - Worldometer](https://www.worldometers.info/world-population/bosnia-and-herzegovina-population): Bosnia & Herzegovina demographics with UN population projections
- [Paraguay Population (2026) - Worldometer](https://www.worldometers.info/world-population/paraguay-population): Paraguay population statistics: growth, density, UN projections
- [Luxembourg Population (2026) - Worldometer](https://www.worldometers.info/world-population/luxembourg-population): Luxembourg demographics: population, fertility, urban growth stats
- [Togo Population (2026) - Worldometer](https://www.worldometers.info/world-population/togo-population): Togo population data: growth rate, density, UN projections
- [Guadeloupe Population (2026) - Worldometer](https://www.worldometers.info/world-population/guadeloupe-population): Guadeloupe population stats: growth, density, fertility, UN data
- [American Samoa Population (2026) - Worldometer](https://www.worldometers.info/world-population/american-samoa-population): American Samoa demographics: population density, growth, urbanization
- [Kiribati Population (2026) - Worldometer](https://www.worldometers.info/world-population/kiribati-population): Kiribati Pacific island demographics with UN population data

- [Togo CO2 Emissions - Worldometer](https://www.worldometers.info/co2-emissions/togo-co2-emissions): Togo CO2 emissions: fossil fuel data and per capita statistics
- [Benin CO2 Emissions - Worldometer](https://www.worldometers.info/co2-emissions/benin-co2-emissions): Benin carbon emissions: historical fossil fuel and per capita data
